product_overview: SaasChurch Next.js is a multitenant church management platform with an administrative MRM panel, a public institutional portal, and logged-in member experiences. It supports member management, secretarial workflows, finance, EBD, events, pastoral services, and system administration within context-aware access rules.
core_goals: Authenticate users and route them to the correct experience based on account status
Manage church members, including registration, lookup, profile updates, and CSV import
Process secretarial workflows such as baptism, consecration, credential requests, transfer requests, and admission/readmission requests
Handle finance operations such as accounts payable, transactions, cash status, reports, and lookup maintenance
Support EBD operations including products, stock, deliveries, and financial tracking
Allow users to switch context between field, regional, and church when permitted
Manage system users, roles, permissions, and audit history
Provide public and member-facing portals for institutional content and personal access

features.name: Login and account access
features.description: Users can sign in with email and password, recover access, and complete second-factor verification when required. Active users enter the main app area, while inactive profiles are sent to a pending activation state.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the logged-in area
Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the form -> See a login error
Navigate to /auth/register -> Fill in the registration form -> Submit the form -> See a pending activation state
Navigate to /auth/forgot-password -> Request a password reset link -> See confirmation of the request
Navigate to /auth/reset-password -> Open the reset flow from the email link -> Set a new password -> Submit the form -> See successful completion
Navigate to /auth/two-factor-verify -> Enter the verification code -> Submit the form -> Complete sign-in

features.name: Protected application access
features.description: Authenticated users can access the logged-in application shell and its protected routes, while unauthenticated users are redirected back to login.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui while signed out -> See redirection to /auth/login
Navigate to /app-ui after signing out -> Try to use protected pages again -> Return to login instead of reopening the app area
Open /app-ui/dashboard/field while signed out -> See the login page instead of protected content

features.name: Member management
features.description: Users can search members, create new records, open member profiles, edit existing data, and review title history from the member area.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/members -> Search for a member by name -> See the filtered list -> Open the member profile -> Review title and function history
Navigate to /app-ui/members/new -> Fill in the new member form -> Submit the form -> See the member created
Navigate to /app-ui/members -> Open an existing member for editing -> Change the registration data -> Save the form -> See the updated record
Navigate to /app-ui/members -> Leave required fields empty in the creation form -> Submit the form -> See validation messages

features.name: Member CSV import
features.description: Users can import members from a CSV file using a two-step process that validates the file before execution.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/members/import -> Select a CSV file -> See the validation report with accepted and rejected rows
Navigate to /app-ui/members/import -> Review the validation results -> Confirm the import execution -> See the imported members

features.name: Baptism requests
features.description: Users can open baptism requests, search for a member inside the request form, select multiple requests, and delete selected requests in bulk.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/baptism-requests -> Open a new baptism request -> Search for the member in the form -> Submit the request -> See the request created
Navigate to /app-ui/baptism-requests -> Mark multiple requests -> Confirm the bulk deletion -> See the selected requests removed
Navigate to /app-ui/baptism-requests -> Start adding a request -> Observe the loading indicator during inclusion -> See the request appear after completion

features.name: Consecration requests
features.description: Users can create consecration requests for a member, choose a title from available options, apply the title matrix, and remove multiple requests at once.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/consecration-requests -> Create a consecration request for a member -> Choose a title from the available options -> Submit the request -> See the request created
Navigate to /app-ui/consecration-requests -> Open an existing request -> Apply the title matrix -> See the request updated according to the matrix
Navigate to /app-ui/consecration-requests -> Select several requests -> Confirm deletion -> See the selected requests removed

features.name: Membership admission and readmission
features.description: Users can open admission or readmission requests, approve them during review, and see the member's previous ecclesiastical title restored on readmission when applicable.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/membership-requests -> Open a readmission request for a former member -> Review the request -> Approve it -> See the request completed
Navigate to /app-ui/membership-requests -> Approve a readmission request -> Open the member profile -> See the previous ecclesiastical title restored

features.name: Accounts payable
features.description: Users can manage vendors, create payable accounts with installments, approve pending accounts, register installment payments, reverse payments, and generate payable reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Create a vendor -> Save the vendor -> See it listed
Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Create a payable account with installments -> Submit the form -> See the account created
Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Open a pending account -> Approve it -> See the status updated
Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Register payment for an installment -> See the installment marked as paid
Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Reverse a recorded payment -> Confirm the reversal -> See the payment status changed
Navigate to /app-ui/finance/contas-a-pagar -> Open the payable report -> See the report generated

features.name: Finance transactions and dashboard
features.description: Users can review financial entries, access a consolidated financial dashboard, and work with financial summaries.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/finance/transactions -> Review income and expense entries -> Filter the list -> See the matching transactions
Navigate to /app-ui/financial-dashboard -> Open the dashboard -> Review consolidated financial indicators -> See the summary charts and totals

features.name: EBD management
features.description: Users can manage EBD products, stock entries, deliveries, negotiation tracking, and trimester reports from the EBD module.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/ebd -> Register an EBD product -> Save the product -> See it in the catalog
Navigate to /app-ui/ebd -> Record a stock entry -> Confirm the entry -> See the stock updated
Navigate to /app-ui/ebd -> Create a delivery for a church -> Submit the delivery -> See the delivery registered
Navigate to /app-ui/ebd -> Open quarterly reports -> Review the trimester data -> See the financial and stock summaries

features.name: Church context switching
features.description: Users with access can switch the active context between field, regional, and church, with access verification when required.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/church-selector -> Open the available contexts -> Choose a field -> Confirm the password when requested -> See the screen update to the selected context
Navigate to /app-ui/church-selector -> Try to access a field without permission -> See access denied

features.name: User, role, and permission management
features.description: Administrators can create users, assign roles, adjust individual permissions, and edit the permission matrix for roles.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/system/users -> Create a user -> Assign a role -> Save the user -> See it listed
Navigate to /app-ui/system/users -> Open a user for permission editing -> Change individual permissions -> Save -> See the updated permissions
Navigate to /app-ui/system/permissions -> Open the role matrix -> Change role permissions -> Save -> See the matrix updated
Navigate to /app-ui/system/users -> Verify a user without permission cannot access a restricted screen -> See the restricted access behavior

features.name: Audit log
features.description: Users can review the system audit trail and filter records by user and date range, including recent logins.
user_flows: Navigate to /app-ui/system/audit-log -> Open the audit trail -> See the activity history
Navigate to /app-ui/system/audit-log -> Filter by user and period -> Apply the filters -> See the matching audit entries
Navigate to /app-ui/system/audit-log -> Check the latest records -> Confirm that the recent login appears

features.name: Public website and department portals
features.description: Visitors can browse the public institutional website and department sites, and submit contact forms without logging in.
user_flows: Navigate to /public -> Browse the public pages -> Open institutional content -> See the site without authentication
Navigate to /portal/dept/:slug -> Open a published department site by slug -> See the department page
Navigate to /public -> Open the contact form -> Submit the form -> See the submission confirmation

features.name: Member portal
features.description: Logged-in members can access their own portal for schedule, devotional content, profile editing, and personal member information.
user_flows: Navigate to /membro -> Enter the member portal -> See the personal dashboard
Navigate to /membro -> Open the schedule -> Review upcoming items -> See the agenda
Navigate to /membro -> Open the daily bread content -> Read the devotional entry -> See the available content
Navigate to /membro -> Open the profile -> Edit personal data -> Save changes -> See the updated profile
Navigate to /membro -> Review personal data access -> Confirm that other members' data is not visible

known_limitations.issue: A aplicacao logada e uma SPA client-side carregada por uma unica rota catch-all do Next, com ssr desativado
known_limitations.impact: Toda rota sob /app-ui responde HTTP 200 com um shell vazio antes do JavaScript rodar; a verificacao de rota protegida so pode ser feita depois que a tela renderiza, nao pelo status da resposta

known_limitations.issue: A guarda de sessao roda no cliente, dentro de um efeito do AppSPA, e nao em middleware do servidor
known_limitations.impact: Existe uma janela em que a tela protegida aparece antes do redirecionamento; a protecao real depende das checagens em cada rota de API

known_limitations.issue: O ambiente de desenvolvimento aponta para o mesmo projeto Supabase configurado no .env
known_limitations.impact: Testes que criam, alteram ou excluem registros gravam na mesma base usada fora do teste; nao ha base separada de testes

known_limitations.issue: Existem 365 rotas de API sob src/app/api sem uma camada unica de autorizacao declarada
known_limitations.impact: A checagem de permissao e feita rota a rota, o que abre espaco para alguma rota ficar sem a verificacao de papel ou de contexto de campo

known_limitations.issue: Ha varios scripts soltos na raiz do projeto que acessam o banco diretamente
known_limitations.location: raiz do repositorio (check_db_schema.js, db_query.js, create_tables.js, fix_participants_rls.js e outros)
known_limitations.impact: Codigo de manutencao versionado junto da aplicacao, fora do fluxo de migracao do Prisma
